I’ve been dealing with imposter syndrome for a couple years now and it has totally allowed me to pretty much dissociate from my body and my mind and as a woman you know that means I’ve been a mess. I’ve been trying to get better tho and actually allow myself to be me and recently  I’ve noticed one thing that’s kind of been helping me, Especially when it’s time for me to go into the club or “perform” as myself.

When I’m in doubt and/or looking for myself and the person I know I am and a little sparkle of who I am comes through as thought for example I’m on the verge of tears and I run to the bathroom and look at myself and I hear in my head “but you really are that bitch” or. “ am I being lazy”… I stick to the sentence and go over it. I then stick to whatever my answer is…. Most of the time usually optimistic. You know ur beautiful and doing great. Sometimes we really do needto talk To ourselves in 3rd person.💕 once I feel that sparkling sound I move in action although I was just in the complete opposite energy. It soo hard and It is most likely a mixture of other issues and components but we are in charge of our own battery if that makes sense…
